name: Overhead Set to Target at Game Speed
setup: Athletic stance on the court with a volleyball, a partner or a wall ready.
cues: Full game speed now: if it gets sloppy, drop back to the slower version.
Get under the ball, then push it up and out to the target in a high arc.
Get to the spot first, then play the ball.

faults.fault: Reaching for the ball instead of moving to it
faults.fix: Move the feet first and get behind the ball, then play it.
Stop square to the target before the ball arrives.
